_comment: T-31 Tauri third-party asset gate (scripts/check-tauri-third-party.mjs, npm run check:tauri-third-party). T-31 0.2.11 third-party asset gate (scripts/check-third-party.mjs, npm run check:third-party). `map`: EXACT file path -> licence id (no globs: the gate fails on a wide glob and on any bundled file missing here). Paths are as bundled: repo-relative for files in the repo, node_modules/... for npm extraResources, rooms-video/... and models/... for the owner-flavour videos and the afterPack default avatar. Add an entry ONLY for an asset whose origin and licence were verified (evidence listed). `noticeKey` = text that must appear in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md (the gate fails when it does not). `unverified`: bundled assets with no verified licence yet; they stay unmapped so the gate stays red and prints the reason. `attested`: path -> {source, date, sha256}; OWNER-ATTESTED only when the 5 text fields are non-empty AND the shipped file hashes to sha256 (else ATTEST-INCOMPLETE / ATTESTATION-STALE, every flavour). Room plates: owner event owner record, note f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000008929, 2026-10-26.
